group_manifest.proof_strategy: For both witnesses choose head_dispatch_case and nodes_dispatch_case to be the already-owned head/list. Reuse the original xizi_dll and xizi_dll_node resources under the anchor pure fact, then construct the post-update wand from an equality of result lists. In the member case the anchor is the explicit In premise and both result predicates are syntactically identical. In the sentinel case choose the equality arm of anchor, use the suffixed xizi_dll_head_not_in helper to obtain ~In head nodes without losing ownership, apply seed lemma xizi_insert_before_absent_append__dispatch_case_derivations, rewrite the transformed list to nodes ++ [inserted], and close the reflexive wand by direct wand introduction/cancellation.

candidate_helper_declarations.statement_shape: forall head nodes, xizi_dll head nodes |-- “ ~ In head nodes ” && xizi_dll head nodes

premises.spatial_resource: Open the sentinel links and induct over dllseg; every nonempty segment cell carries node<>stop, then rebuild the unchanged resource.

candidate_helper_declarations.proof_hint: Prove the segment-level no-stop-membership fact by induction on nodes while preserving the segment resource, then expose/rebuild xizi_dll. Do not add an algorithmic mirror of the C code.

group_entry.proof_strategy: For both witnesses choose head_dispatch_case and nodes_dispatch_case to be the already-owned head/list. Reuse the original xizi_dll and xizi_dll_node resources under the anchor pure fact, then construct the post-update wand from an equality of result lists. In the member case the anchor is the explicit In premise and both result predicates are syntactically identical. In the sentinel case choose the equality arm of anchor, use the suffixed xizi_dll_head_not_in helper to obtain ~In head nodes without losing ownership, apply seed lemma xizi_insert_before_absent_append__dispatch_case_derivations, rewrite the transformed list to nodes ++ [inserted], and close the reflexive wand by direct wand introduction/cancellation.
group_entry.natural_language_proof_strategy: The weaker dispatch contract can be instantiated with exactly the caller's current abstract list. Membership already proves admissibility in the member case. For the sentinel case the concrete cyclic-list predicate ensures the sentinel never occurs among data nodes, so insert-before at the sentinel is append. Once the transformed abstract list is identified, each residual wand maps a predicate to itself.

premise_discharge.member_anchor: The VC precondition is exactly In linklist_pre nodes_member_case.
premise_discharge.sentinel_anchor: Choose the anchor equality alternative linklist_pre=linklist_pre.
premise_discharge.sentinel_absence: Derived from xizi_dll linklist_pre nodes_sentinel_case via xizi_dll_head_not_in__dispatch_case_derivations; dllseg's nonempty branch records each node<>stop.
premise_discharge.sentinel_result_equality: Apply annotation-approved seed lemma xizi_insert_before_absent_append__dispatch_case_derivations to the derived ~In fact.
premise_discharge.spatial_resources: The pre-owned xizi_dll and xizi_dll_node become the dispatch precondition; the wand is proved after rewriting its antecedent/consequent to the same xizi_dll predicate.

group_entry.grouping_reason: Both witnesses derive the same existential dispatch contract and the same reflexive magic-wand pattern; only the sentinel branch adds one local no-sentinel-membership helper. Keeping them together allows one worker to reuse the exact existential and wand proof structure.
